title: Uniform sign-cube variance identity
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its variance under the product of uniform sign distributions equals its variance under the uniform distribution on the whole cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
